_comment: Curated reference-voice archetypes for zero-shot cloning via IndicF5. No entry here is a real/identifiable person's recording — each is a generic sample clip used only as a style/timbre reference. `ref_text` MUST be the exact transcript of what is spoken in `file`; if you add a new clip, verify its transcript (e.g. via the existing Whisper adapter in agents/voice_provider.py) before using it, since a wrong ref_text degrades cloning quality rather than just being cosmetically wrong.

voices.ref_text: ਭਹੰਪੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਮਾਰਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਭਵਨ ਨਿਰਮਾਣ ਕਲਾ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਗੁੰਝਲਦਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਹੈਰਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਨ, ਜੋ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਖੁਸ਼ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
